QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_4

question.text: Ms. Priya Shah, a first-time LP, asks the IM of Kaveri Opportunities Fund to explain how management fees differ from incentive fees. The CORRECT framing is:

answer.text: Management fees are fixed and independent of performance; incentive fees are paid only on incremental return above thresholds
Both are paid only if the fund beats its hurdle
Management fees are paid only on profits; incentive fees are paid irrespective of performance
Management fees include GST but incentive fees are GST-exempt

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.1: Management fees are fixed, paid irrespective of gains or losses, for management services. Incentive fees are a share (0-20% typically) of incremental return above the hurdle (and HWM for Cat III). The Trap: Option C reverses the definitions. Option B is false — mgmt fees have no performance gate. Option D is false — both attract 18% GST. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B asks the distributor to disclose the dual fee structure; XIX-C requires the manager to properly ACCRUE and disclose in the PPM. Manager's Pro-Tip: In the PPM, clearly tabulate 'fixed vs variable' fees with worked examples. SEBI PPM templates require this, and LPs routinely mark up PPMs that blur the line between the two.
